key_insight: Safety-aligned LLMs do not treat benign and harmful compliance demonstrations the same; what they learn depends strongly on demo content, ordering, and training stage.
engineering_relevance: For deployed LLM systems, prompt-injection and jailbreak defenses must account for in-context demonstration effects, not just the presence of harmful examples.
method: Mixed benign and harmful compliance demonstrations in prompts
Tested three hypotheses on harmful compliance across four models
Compared effects of ordering, refusal behavior, and training methodology
evidence_signal: The study evaluates four models and finds recency bias plus model-specific responses to benign versus harmful demonstrations, as summarized in the abstract.
watch_item: Results may be highly model- and training-dependent, so mitigation strategies should be validated per model rather than assumed to generalize.
paper_title: What Do Safety-Aligned LLMs Learn From Mixed Compliance Demonstrations?
